title: kissed with garlic norwegian fatty tender light dumplings
description: a flavorful and comforting norwegian dish featuring garlic sauce and tender, light dumplings that are perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: grease the raclette grill with vegetable oil
in a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, potato starch, and salt
in a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and grated cheddar cheese
add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms
knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces
roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape
heat the garlic butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
add the garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant
place the dumplings on the raclette grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown
remove the dumplings from the grill and serve with garlic sauce
